description.narrative: "This grant will contribute to advancing the rights of girls, women and trans people in the DRC through its flexibility that allows AFECOJU to focus priorities in terms of organizational capacity building and leadership.This grant also supports:- Capacity building of members - Training of the group's board members, the administrative and financial secretary and the accountant in financial management and the use of management tools, activists;- Advocacy for the prevention and fight against violence against women and girls- Training of national, regional and international health services- Empowerment and economic reintegration of women and girls- Initiative for the promotion and support of female entrepreneurship- Operational costs- Monitoring and evaluation strategies"
